recipes.title: Savory Shakshuka
recipes.description: Poached eggs in a spiced tomato sauce, perfect for a hearty breakfast.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of olive oil in a skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes until shimmering.
Add chopped onion and bell pepper, cooking for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in minced garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add canned tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes until thickened, stirring occasionally.
Make 4 wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each well, covering and cooking for 6-8 minutes until set.
Sprinkle crumbled feta cheese and parsley over the shakshuka, then serve immediately.

recipes.title: Classic French Toast
recipes.description: Golden brown slices of bread soaked in a creamy vanilla custard and pan-fried.
instructions: Whisk together 2 large eggs, milk, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and salt in a shallow bowl.
Dip each slice of bread into the egg mixture, allowing it to soak for 30 seconds.
Heat 1 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium heat until melted and bubbling.
Add soaked bread slices to the skillet, cooking for 3-4 minutes on each side until golden brown.
Serve warm with a drizzle of maple syrup over the top and enjoy!

recipes.title: Corned Beef Hash with Eggs
recipes.description: A savory, satisfying mix of corned beef, potatoes, and eggs for a filling morning meal.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat for 2 minutes until hot.
Add diced potatoes and chopped onion, cooking for 10 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Stir in diced corned beef, and cook for an additional 5 minutes until heated through.
Create two wells in the hash and crack an egg into each, cooking for 6 minutes until set.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot.

recipes.title: Savory Spinach and Feta Omelette
recipes.description: Fluffy omelette filled with fresh spinach and tangy feta cheese.
instructions: Whisk together 4 large eggs, season with salt and pepper to taste.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add 1 cup chopped spinach to the skillet and sauté for 2 minutes until wilted.
Pour eggs over the spinach and cook for 4 minutes until set on the bottom.
Sprinkle 50g crumbled feta cheese on top, then fold the omelette in half.
Serve warm and enjoy your delicious spinach and feta omelette!

recipes.title: Chia Seed Pudding with Mango
recipes.description: Nutritious chia pudding layered with sweet, ripe mango.
instructions: Combine 1/4 cup chia seeds, 1 cup almond milk, 1 tbsp honey, and 1/2 tsp vanilla extract in a bowl.
Stir well and let it sit for 5 minutes before stirring again to prevent clumping.
After 5 minutes, refrigerate the mixture for at least 2 hours to thicken.
Scoop into bowls and top with 1 diced mango.
Serve chilled and enjoy your refreshing chia seed pudding!

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Avocado Toast
recipes.description: Creamy avocado on roasted sweet potato slices for a delicious open-faced sandwich.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°C for roasting the sweet potatoes.
Slice 1 large sweet potato into 1/2 inch thick rounds and place on a baking tray.
Drizzle with 1 tbsp olive oil, season with salt and pepper to taste, then toss.
Roast the sweet potatoes in the oven at 220°C for 25 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile, mash 1 ripe avocado with 1 tbsp lemon juice, and season with salt and pepper.
Spread the mashed avocado onto the roasted sweet potato rounds once they're done.
Sprinkle with chili flakes for an extra kick and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Shakshuka
recipes.description: Enjoy a spicy, flavorful North African egg dish in a rich tomato sauce.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat until shimmering.
Add 1 diced onion and sauté for 5 minutes until softened and translucent.
Incorporate 3 minced garlic cloves and 1 chopped bell pepper, cooking for 3 more minutes.
Stir in 400g canned tomatoes, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, salt, and pepper to taste, and simmer.
Make 4 wells in the sauce and crack one egg into each well, then cover and cook for 6-8 minutes.
Garnish with fresh parsley before serving hot directly from the skillet.

recipes.title: Japanese Tamagoyaki
recipes.description: Master this delicate Japanese rolled omelette for a taste of Umami perfection.
instructions: Whisk together 4 eggs, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp mirin, 1 tsp sugar, and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and lightly grease it with vegetable oil.
Pour a thin layer of egg mixture into the pan, tilting to coat evenly, and cook until set.
Roll the omelette towards you, then push it to one side of the pan and repeat with more egg mixture.
After rolling, shape with a sushi mat and let rest for a moment. Slice and serve warm.

recipes.title: Chia Seed Pudding with Tropical Fruits
recipes.description: Dive into a refreshing, healthy breakfast bursting with flavors and vibrant fruits.
instructions: Combine 1/4 cup chia seeds, 1 cup coconut milk, 2 tbsp honey, and 1 tsp vanilla extract in a bowl.
Whisk together the mixture for about 2 minutes until well combined and thickened slightly.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight, until set and creamy.
Before serving, top with diced mango, sliced kiwi, sliced banana, and a squeeze of lime.
Garnish with fresh mint leaves for a bright finish.

recipes.title: Savory Veggie Quinoa Bowl
recipes.description: A hearty bowl of quinoa topped with sautéed veggies and a poached egg.
instructions: Rinse 1 cup of quinoa under cold water and combine with 2 cups water in a pot.
Bring the pot with quinoa to a boil over high heat, then reduce to low and cover.
Chop 1 small bell pepper and sauté in 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add 2 cups of spinach to the pan and cook until wilted, season with 1/4 teaspoon each of salt and pepper.
Poach 1 large egg in simmering water for 3-4 minutes until the white is set.
Serve the quinoa topped with sautéed veggies and the poached egg for a nutritious breakfast.

recipes.title: Avocado Toast with Tomato Salsa
recipes.description: Crispy toast topped with creamy avocado and fresh tomato salsa for a delightful start.
instructions: Toast 2 slices of whole grain bread until golden brown and crispy over medium heat.
Scoop and mash 1/2 large avocado with a fork, then season with 1/4 teaspoon of salt and pepper.
Chop 1 medium tomato, 1/4 small red onion, and 1 tablespoon of cilantro, then mix with 1 tablespoon of lime juice.
Spread the mashed avocado evenly over the toasted bread and top with the tomato salsa.

recipes.title: Chickpea Pancakes with Spinach
recipes.description: Fluffy chickpea pancakes filled with sautéed spinach and spices, vibrant and nutritious!
instructions: Combine 1 cup of chickpea flour with 1 cup of water to create a smooth batter.
Add 1/2 teaspoon each of turmeric, cumin, and 1/4 teaspoon of salt to the batter and mix well.
Chop 1 cup of spinach and sauté with 1 clove of minced garlic in 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat until wilted.
In a non-stick skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium-high heat, then pour in 1/4 cup of batter per pancake.
Flip the pancake once golden brown, cooking for another 2-3 minutes on the other side.
Serve warm, topped with sautéed spinach for a flavorful breakfast.
